summary: Darkness S1 (our 1-12) adapts main chs 1-17 plus two bonus chapters ('First Love' v3 in ep8, 'Room' v4 in ep12), roughly 1.5 chapters per episode, with one relocation: ch11 is skipped in ep8 and placed after ch13 at the end of ep9. Darkness 2nd (our 13-24) adapts chs 20-42 but opens with ch26 pulled forward (ep13), grafts ch27 into ep14, pulls the vol-12 bonus chapters 'Adhesion Panic' and 'Bath' forward into eps 17-18, uses only fragments of ch38 in ep23, and ends mid-Darkness-arc at ch42; the arc's finish (chs 43-47) exists only as the two specials (AniList 21852, counted as eps 25-26 by animefillerlist - our drop rule is right), after which the manga resumes at ch48. Chs 18-19 and 28 plus most bonus chapters are animated only in the 6 Darkness OVAs (AniList 13851); ch38, 49-50 and 54-55 only in the 2016 2nd OVAs (21853). The stored ep24->55 anchor is wrong (it is the last chapter animated anywhere, not the TV end) and is repaired to 42 (vol 11). All 24 TV episodes are manga canon; fandom's chapter pages give a complete chapter->episode reverse map that agrees with Wikipedia's episode titles (which equal chapter titles) and summaries, so every anchor is high confidence.

structure.notes: Our 24 = TV only: CONFIRMED. AniList 13663 = 12 TV eps (our 1-12, Oct-Dec 2012); AniList 20995 = 12 TV eps (our 13-24, Jul-Sep 2015). AniList 21852 'To LOVE-Ru Darkness 2nd Specials' (MAL 31711) = 2 eps described by AniList as 'Episodes 13 and 14 of Darkness 2nd' (Wikipedia and ja-wiki number them 13-14, dated 2015-10-28); animefillerlist counts them as eps 25-26 of a 26-episode 'To Love Ru: Darkness' (all manga canon), so SOURCE_NUMBERING_SHIFTS drop [25,26] is correct. Component 3 (21852) is null-null: recommend order_only after 20995 adapting chs 43-47 (special 1 = 43-45, special 2 = 46-47); a viewer who also watches the specials resumes the manga at ch48. Not in our components: AniList 13851 'To LOVE-Ru Darkness OVA' (6 eps, 2012-2015, bundled with manga vols 5,6,8,9,12,13) and AniList 21853 'To LOVE-Ru Darkness 2nd OVA' (3 eps, 2016) plus a 4th 2017 OVA 'Multiplication' (post-series omake). Chapter numbering: main chapters 1-77 (+ ch0 prologue) as on Wikipedia/fandom/MU; bonus chapters are unnumbered 'bangaihen' inside volumes (22 in tankobon) - AniList's 100 = 77 + prologue + 22 bonus. Anchors use MAIN numbering; bonus chapters are named with their volume.

flags_for_sean: Flag #685 (MU 77 vs AniList 100) resolved: same edition. MU counts the 77 numbered main chapters; AniList counts 77 + prologue (ch0) + 22 in-volume bonus chapters = 100 (fandom counts 102 incl. two post-series 'Multiplication' bangaihen). Anchors use main numbering (max main = 77, max animated main = 55 via 2nd OVA 3). Suggest treating total_chapters as 77 for chapter math, or keep 100 but note bonus chapters are unnumbered.
Existing ep24->55 v14 anchor repaired to 42 v11 (see repairs); 55 matches the last main chapter animated anywhere (2016 OVA), not the TV finale.

Page-level splits (ch3, ch8, ch15, ch33, ch40 across episode boundaries) are inferred by correlating Wikipedia episode summaries with fandom chapter summaries and the fandom 'adapted in episodes X and Y' statements; no page numbers are cited by any source.
